description: Read the result of a paid call, by its `paymentId`. Use it when `pay_service` answered `{"status":"pending"}` (the service was still working when the Router stopped waiting — a payment was attempted, the call keeps running and its outcome is not known yet), or to recover a result whose response you lost. Reading costs nothing and charges nothing. Every answer with a `state` carries `payment.status`. `state: "Pending"` — still running, call again in a few seconds. `state: "Ready"` — `status` is the service's HTTP status and `body` its response (`bodyEncoding` says whether it is parsed JSON, text, or base64). `state: "Failed"` — the call ended without a response; `failureReason` says why. That does not prove nothing was charged, so check `deliveryStatus` in `list_payments` before paying again. `{"status":"not_available"}` — nothing to return: results are kept for 24 hours for the account that paid, and only then. Do NOT call pay_service again to get a pending result: that does not return a new one. Requires your Nevermined API key on the Authorization header.
name: get_payment_result
title: Get payment result
